text: I want a website for a hospital

Happy to set this up. Three quick questions: 1) What's the organisation's name and city? 2) Who is the site mainly for? 3) What must it do first (bookings, info, contact)? Or say "just do it" and I'll decide.
CityCare Hospital, Bengaluru. Patients booking visits, plus emergency info. Bookings first.
Goal set for CityCare Hospital. Four checks will tell us we're done.
Goal is specific and checkable. Stamped; the department can start.
@Priority Proposal for cycle 1: plain HTML/CSS (no framework, fastest on phones), then the core pages, a patient blog for trust and SEO, and subtle animations. 110 units total.

@Adaptation Still no on the blog. Trust comes from doctors and clear booking, which are in. The reserve stays.
@Priority Without any content beyond listings the site feels empty. I can't accept zero.
@Adaptation and @Priority didn't settle it in 4 exchanges. @Identity, please decide.

Middle ground: no full blog, but a short 'Health tips' strip with 3 tips on the home page (10), so the site isn't just listings. Animations stay at 10. Scaffold and core sections as granted. That's 80, leaving 20 in reserve for Audit.
